Goblin sharks are deep-sea hunters, dwelling near the ocean floor. They make up for their slow swimming speed with stealthy ambushes, allowing prey to get within reach before lashing out with their extending jaws. **[Recall Knowledge - Animal](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 20 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 18 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 15 [Goblin Shark](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3307) **Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 179 **Perception** +15; blood scent, electrolocation 20 feet, [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 100 feet **Languages** **Skills** [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) +13, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) +15, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=49) +10 **Str** +6 **Dex** +4 **Con** +5 **Int** -4 **Wis** +3 **Cha** -3 **Blood Scent** The shark can smell blood in the water from up to 1 mile away.
**Camouflage** The goblin shark's coloration blends in with the water. It doesn't need cover to attempt to [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404) with a [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) check while underwater.
**Electrolocation** A goblin shark can sense minute electrical charges in living creatures, which it can use as a [precise sense](/Rules.aspx?ID=411) at a range of 20 feet. --- **AC** 21 **Fort** +16 **Ref** +11 **Will** +10 **HP** 85 **Grasping Jaws** Creatures that successfully [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296) from the goblin shark's jaws take 1d6 [persistent bleed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) as the shark's hold tears flesh away. --- **Speed** swim 20 feet **Melee** jaws +13, **Damage** 2d8+6 piercing plus [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45) **Lunging Bite** The goblin shark dashes forward and extends its jaws bite a creature. It swims up to 10 feet in a straight line and makes a jaws Strike with a reach of 10 feet.
name: Goblin Shark
